description: FREE — no payment or wallet: Poll a crawl job started with readfetch_crawl. FREE — no payment or wallet; unauthenticated. Pass `id` from the crawl response. Returns job_id, status (queued, running, complete, or failed), completed/total counts, and a growing `pages` list (url plus Markdown) as results land. Stop polling when status is complete or failed. Results are kept for one hour after the job finishes.

id.description: Job id from readfetch_crawl (`job_id` in the start response). Required for MCP tools/call; poll until status is complete or failed (results kept ~1 hour).

name: readfetch_crawl_status
